saw_lines: Lighting buyers rarely shop by lumens. They pick one light for one spot, then come back for the same finish.
So the sale is won in the ad, where a buyer checks whether a light fits their wall before reading the price.
Your site explains shipping, yet only a few of your 30 ads name it, so repeat your 24 hour delivery in the first line of ads for new buyers.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains shipping, yet only a few of your 30 ads name it, so a new buyer has no delivery promise before the click. Repeat your 24 hour delivery in the first line of ads for new buyers.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing LED brands has nothing to trust. Pick one figure you can back, like review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

Four ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product in the ad, so each click starts a search. Point each to the product or collection its creative shows, so the buyer lands on the light the ad showed.
Only 2 of your 30 ads mention a discount, both in your oldest ads, so a first time buyer has no first order offer today. Launch a bundle of two lights with a new code in line one of three new ads.
